Corporate Partnerships

Make an Impact on the Future of Music

Connect your brand with powerful audiences, amplify your company’s visibility, and advance your organization’s philanthropic impact. Learn more about partnership opportunities through customized engagement initiatives or event sponsorship.

Amplify Your Visibility

Support the NEC Community

Corporate Engagement Opportunities

Elevate your marketing and engagement initiatives while directly impacting the NEC community. Each partnership is customized to meet the goals of your brand by leveraging NEC’s talented and influential network of constituents and its position as a longstanding cultural institution in Boston.

Learn More

Amplify Your Visibility

Spring Scholarship Gala Sponsorship

The Annual Scholarship Gala is a significant driver of NEC’s ability to award scholarships to deserving students, more than 90% of whom rely on scholarship support to pursue their academic and artistic careers.

Learn More

Opportunities and Benefits

We Value Your Partnership

NEC’s corporate partnership opportunities offer a range of benefits throughout the year, including brand recognition and visibility to a variety of constituencies served by the conservatory:

  • Engagement with 125 community partnerships that impact education, growth, and healing in the city of Boston.
  • Visibility to more than 20,000 local NEC concert goers and over 100,000 digital audience members in NEC’s concert programs.
  • Corporate logos featured on the NEC website with more than 500,000 unique users.
  • Access to a robust network of more than 115,000 followers across all social media platforms.

Contact Us

For more information on engagement and sponsorship opportunities, please get in touch with Stephanie Gozali, NEC’s Director of Annual Programs & Engagement.
